title: [Track P / v0-M7 Stage2B2][RELEASED Gate0 → conditional A-only] R776 native coverage diagnostic
body:
Track: Coordination → **Track P (Production Compiler), v0-M7 Stage2B2 focused post-BLIND coverage diagnosis and conditional faithful repair**.

# P #778 — frozen R776 H+T coverage gap: exact first refusal → conditional narrow P candidate

**STATUS: INTAKE HOLD until C explicit follow-up RELEASE comment.** This is a **NEW, distinct post-first-pass P follow-up task**, not a retroactive correction of the immutable P #774 result and **NOT** an R §7.6 mechanical rerun or authorization to merge.

## Authority / evidence and execution
- **Fixed Compiler/main:** `168c1cdafe929051ef08ff58f858fab045b17763`, [CURRENT_SPEC](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/main/docs/reference/CURRENT_SPEC.md) → normative **Draft17.34**, esp §16.3.8 one completed H recursive nominal plus one exact-two-u8 T nominal in a single semantic unit; §3, §16–18 source/known body and nonCopy local RETURN, §20 ref/currentness/origin, §24 affine, §26–27.
- **Immutable predecessor Production candidate:** `96922455e18f0bd103c7bc7a208dbe915ed7ea98` at [P DRAFT PR #775](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/pull/775) (base exact merged main; green first FULL5 [#39922187251](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/39922187251) 5×438, PARTIAL [#39922187367](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/39922187367) 437). **DO NOT AMEND / REBASE P #775 or R #777**, preserve original candidate/main histories.
- **Independent fresh [R #776 C adjudication](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/776#issuecomment-6361332793):** first BLIND [freeze](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/776#issuecomment-6360971053) and [terminal](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/776#issuecomment-6361187050); immutable R first-red commit `a2e6a1abd2b4dfe7921aba24cb984aaeec735aba` and [R DRAFT PR #777](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/pull/777) unmerged. **The independent R FIRST-PASS verdict was published BEFORE this task**, so P is allowed to READ and compare R sources/results in a clearly labeled **NON-BLIND calibrated diagnosis**, but NEVER rewrite R branch/source/expected SHA, soften R FIRST PASS, label P regression tests as independent BLIND, or use R-owned source as proof issuer. All R artifacts and evidence remain separate.
- **P execution: P's own Work/Codex-equivalent development environment + NEW P-only branch (branch from immutable P candidate) + focused local compiler/C17/GCC/Clang native + GitHub Actions if conditional code is produced.** NOT normal Chat-only R, and no R code writes. A NEW P-only **DRAFT / DO NOT MERGE** follow-up PR stacked against original P #775 fixed branch, not a rewrite of P #775. Do not edit `main`, `CURRENT_SPEC`, semantic checker/issuer/validator, canonical Draft, workflows/LLVM/toolchain/sanitizer or original P/R evidence. Coordination alone adjudicates P merge/R follow-up.
- At task start use [Compass](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/main/docs/NewLang_Project_Compass.md) to navigate actual [Product Strategy §1.1](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/main/docs/NewLang_Product_Value_Strategy.md#11-ub-prevention-audit-locality-value-hypothesis), [Development Process §§4.2,4.3/4.3.2,7](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/main/docs/NewLang_Project_Development_Process.md), [Design Decision Procedure](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/main/docs/NewLang_Design_Decision_Procedure.md) and DI Ledger when an actual new rule is considered. Risk of goal deviation must be a distinct Issue paragraph.

## What the independent R really found (KEEP FIRST RED)
- Exactly 2 fresh independently frozen, genuinely one-physical-source H+T inputs, `--check` **0**, ordinary `newlangc SOURCE` **4 / V1-BACKEND-UNSUPPORTED / zero C bytes**. In 5 FULL5 jobs each **439/442**, and PARTIAL **438/441**, the same 3 R tests red on native/emitter preflight; all existing tests green. Negative R aggregate PASS, but true public H/T joint proof/world integrity, native GCC/Clang O0/O2, originals/frees/0–2, fresh native sanitizers and positive emitter/OOM **NOT TESTED** because zero C17 emitted. **No observed unsoundness, no proven native correctness.**
- **R-A** (immutable `tests/r776/frozen/positive_h_first.nl`, SHA `a516361123d26de17ac6e5f9a81cc530f50b6509379a960ca20e78a2df0b6a0d`): independently authored *T actions before two H allocations* (therefore looks like P's bounded T-prefix/H-suffix class); but holds returned nonCopy LiveTail first in a named local, then destructures, and terminal cleanup helper includes an extra scoped read loan before destroy. Does any public H producer/returned-world/terminal closure proof remain genuinely source-issued? Is any backend-only guard more restrictive than the normative permitted source? These shape differences are **C hypotheses, NOT verified first-rejection predicates**. R-A also includes two T originals, an authenticated named Copy call and direct old-result use, and frozen 0/1/2 expected physical frees.
- **R-B** (immutable `tests/r776/frozen/positive_t_interposed.nl`, SHA `12c5c66c413a57fd78549cb4563c71c6831d0f151b53b2d4569d32f7b50a1af5`): interposes named fn among H/T declarations, then performs T writes **in the second allocation Some arm after H local-owner producer RETURN**, not as a main straight-line T prefix. Clearly beyond P #774's declared first backend implementation envelope, though CHECK admits it under Draft17.34. Must classify the true additional CFG/issuer/backend work and v0 completion importance; **no code authorization for R-B in this task**. Do not relabel it a grammar error to make candidate green.

## Gate0 required FIRST: bounded READ-ONLY diagnosis and design choice BEFORE implementation
1. Freeze the exact P predecessor SHA/tree, R source/oracle+SHA, current checked-owned graph/witness and R CTest failure log URLs into an Issue first comment. Reproduce actual *unchanged* first failures of R-A and R-B with P candidate, including `--check`, public proof/validator states, CLI4/staged Node emitter status and zero/unchanged output; separate stdout vs stderr, refusal stage, and normal vs named CLI. Do not modify or reissue R first-pass or work around refused source using a P fixture.
2. **Instrument/probe by read-only inspection and non-semantic tracing** to identify the *first exact predicate / graph node / world* causing rejection for A and B. Show relevant producer named body, H local RETURN/receiver/terminal handoff issuer/world/backing Allocation/Domain root/incarnation, actual T helper body proof, first actual T entry/handoff ValueFact/original and sibling, and which copy ledger / H source shape contract or callback cannot be matched. Compare to P #774's two successes using a minimal **semantic-preserving, authorized** structural diff. Distinguish SOURCE INELIGIBLE, source CHECK accepted but insufficient public proof, public validated but backend currently unsupported, compiler unsound acceptance. `--check 0` is not a public authentic owner proof.
3. Decide specifically **A**: can it be emitted with **already existing source-issued H and T permissions**, no new public combined issuer, no copied cross-world rights, no weakened validator, no manufactured carry/original? Estimate narrow changes/maintenance, document whether this is a genuinely generalized backend source-form handling step (not literal field/type/callee name or data specialization). **B**: independently document exact post-owner/H-arm CFG limitation and required extensions, whether v0 completion depends on it, feasibility/risks and a recommended next bounded milestone; do NOT implement B.
4. **HARD STOP before code** if A has no authentic H returned owner/terminal caller evidence, needs a new public proof issuer or language rule, raises unsoundness/provenance mismatch, or requires a general ownership/CFG/effect engine beyond a finite extension. Report a minimal node/metadata counterexample, actual available alternatives: keep fail-closed main/P candidate DRAFT, separately selected legitimate issuer/M/F design, narrower user-authored safe source shape/unchecked where supported, or staged v0 completion. C will re-authorize any semantic/authority expansion via §4.2 and §4.3.2.

## Conditional Stage1: A-only minimum faithful implementation IF and ONLY IF Gate0 passes
5. On NEW P branch from immutable P candidate `96922455...`, implement the **smallest re-usable bounded backend-only handling necessary for R-A** preserving *both* previously-issued independent H and T facts: H two distinct real originals, exact pointer/backing/Allocation/Domain, owner created/consumed/RETURN/local handoff/caller destruction exactly once; T exact caller old Copy/currentness/sibling and two independently original field records. Do not special-case R filenames, field IDs, literals, function names, or preset oracle. Preserve current P #774 named/normal successes and unsupported R-B until separately authorized. New backend ledger can **consume** evidence, must not create or mutate the semantic context/issuer or suppress authentic validators. Before completed staging, no C byte published; negative, resource, OOM/rollback must remain fail-closed.
6. Add a *distinct P-authored* varied positive source(s) exercising same shape/method with different T old/new/field, H original payloads and lexical names (and at least a second ordinary-supported source). The immutable R-A source remains a **separately labeled post-FIRST-PASS calibrated external regression**, not a substituted or edited oracle. If copied verbatim for a regression, preserve its original SHA and provenance. Demonstrate strict generated **unchanged C17 GCC/Clang O0/O2** for 0/1/2 physical malloc failure worlds and original ptr/frees, nonCopy returned owner, T old/new/sibling; selected negatives (wrong backing/Domain/stale/Copy scope/cross-world), selected OOM positions reached, output-slot/named-output preservation and clean retry; no new source/issuer/ABI/API authority. Real ASan/UBSan focused local runs. Preserve original R first-red and P initial test history.
7. **CI budget** if substantive candidate implemented: local frontend/focused sanitizer + exactly **ONE natural first-attempt GitHub Actions FULL5 and distinct NO LLVM PARTIAL** after a single stable P-only DRAFT PR HEAD. Original P candidate baseline **FULL5 438, PARTIAL 437** named tests, plus exactly new K actual named tests; freeze K before Actions. Verify all five FULL5 complete name sets and partial differs only `llvm.c_api`, retain old P suite, Clang pinned fmt, sanitizer and all original R evidence. No suite exclusions, workflow/pin/LLVM changes, no rerun-to-green on substantive red; transparent nonsemantic mechanical correction only via fresh C §7.6 decision. STOP on new authority, unsafe native, unexpected source/issuer refusal or regression. Do not merge or auto-launch R.
8. If Gate0 finds **no narrow safe A repair**, report READ-ONLY STOP without a speculative PR, P code or needless CI. If implementation succeeds, report exact source/oracle hash, original/refined diagnostic, compiler SHA/tree, all CLI/native + fail-world+OOM observations, old P candidate baseline and first CI URLs to Issue and DRAFT PR; C decides NON-BLIND calibrated R recheck of original frozen R-A and whether a further fresh R is necessary for changed trusted boundary.

## Goals / alternatives / stop and measured product boundary
- **Goal:** make a materially different, independently authored *already CHECK-valid* T-prefix+H-return source implementable using the existing source-issued evidence without fixture-specific gates, increasing true v0 source→proof→native completion and information gain.
- **Evidence:** P #774 finite authored P green 5×438 + 437, R #776 independent new native positive FAIL at CLI4, no demonstrated unsoundness or native custody for R sources. Two distinct R actual source shapes and frozen negative evidence enable refutation of a producer-fixture-only profile. Independent R red stays immutable.
- **Alternatives:** preserve fail-closed main; faithful small A support; separately review new public authority under §4.2; broad B post-owner/H-arm T interleaving future milestone if required; consider more user-natural API source and bounded scoped unchecked only if actually supported.
- **STOP:** no authentic source-issued H/T original permission, wrong root/Allocation/Domain, consumer ledger creates new rights, failed scoped loan or lack of proof, native wrong physical owner/UB/leak/dirty OOM, uncontrolled scope/CI, compiler/canonical drift. C owns subsequent R/adoption/merge. No automatic Product GO.
- **VALUE-ALIGNMENT-RISK separate from technical:** compare writer/ordinary-safe caller duties with well-factored C; compiler-only private carrier bookkeeping and explicit cleanup could remain burdensome, and no representation hiding / enforced safe-library facade / §1.1 author+caller audit-re-audit dependency closure improvement is measured. [Product GO #624](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/624) PAUSED / [H1 #268](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/268) HOLD. Label limitations rather than invent improvements.

**No P execution until new explicit C RELEASE comment.**
